name: Calculus: Early Transcendentals, 8th Edition
description: Featuring rigorous proofs, real‑world applications, and a wealth of exercises, this textbook guides students through limits, derivatives, integrals, and series. Visual aids and step‑by‑step examples support conceptual clarity. Online homework platform integrates seamlessly.
shortDescription: A thorough calculus textbook emphasizing early transcendentals and applications.

reviews.title: Solid Coverage, But Some Flaws
reviews.comment: The 8th edition of Calculus: Early Transcendentals offers clear explanations and plenty of worked examples, which helped me follow the concepts. However, the textbook is quite bulky and the price is higher than I expected, and I found a few typographical errors in the problem sets. Overall it serves as a decent reference, but there are areas that could be improved.
